question: Which of the following folk dance forms is NOT associated with the state of Gujarat?
solution:
The correct answer is Hojagiri.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• ** Hojagiri Folk Dance**

 
 
• **In the Indian state of Tripura, members of the Bru Reang tribe perform the hojagiri, a folk dance.**
 
• **Women and young girls execute it in groups of four to six**, singing, dancing, and managing additional props like a bottle on the head and an earthen light in the hand while only the lower half of their bodies are moved.
